statement: TSMC raised its 2026 full-year revenue growth guidance to slightly above 40% in USD terms and raised its 2026 capex projection to $60-64 billion.
why: A capex raise at the foundry that makes nearly every leading accelerator is the strongest available commitment that more chip supply is coming.

impact.mechanism: Higher foundry capex funds additional leading-edge wafer and advanced-packaging capacity, relieving the main physical constraint on accelerator output.

evidence.excerpt: TSMC separately raised its 2026 full-year revenue growth guidance to slightly above 40% in USD terms and raised its 2026 capex projection to $60-64 billion.

confidence.basis: Secondary-tier document; the guidance and capex raise are relayed in this release summary rather than in a fetched primary filing.
